meta.source: Coded from the published QP and mark scheme (4MA1_2F_2311). Derived metadata only. No exam question text transcribed.

coding_notes: q10 is a two-step NUMBER MACHINE, and it overturned an exclusion. function_machines had been removed from the iGCSE courses on 2026-10-08 as absent from both the specification text and the first twelve coded papers. The spec never writes the phrase, but it uses the format as the vehicle for 2.2's 'derive a formula or expression'. Now restored to igcse_foundation. See data/courses.ts — absence of a WORD from a specification is weak evidence, weakest for question formats and for composites of listed content.
q19(b) is an ENLARGEMENT per the mark scheme.

q8 tagged alternate_and_corresponding_angles rather than angles_on_lines_and_circles: two named parallel lines cut by two transversals is squarely that skill, and the reason mark is for naming the angle fact. This is the skill's first sighting in the corpus — it had read as unexamined only because earlier angle questions genuinely sat on the lower node.
q11 tagged proportion for a currency conversion graph, following the precedent in docs/coding-a-paper.md; (a) reads values off the line, (b) scales beyond its range.
q14 tagged exact_calculations — calculator evaluation with all display figures written down.
q16 tagged volume_of_a_prism: the route is how many 20 cm cubes fit across each inside dimension, then the least height. The packing reasoning has no node of its own.
